description: Reads how many registered, how many came live, how many stayed long enough to see the offer, and how many watched the replay, with the show-up rate. Take it when a host asks how the evening went, for example "How many actually showed up?" It needs the session id and reads only from the connected site. It changes nothing, and it does not read money or single persons. A rate appears only when at least 20 people were in the earlier step; below that the answer says so instead of making up a percentage. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step. Words hosts use: show-up rate, attendance, participants, replay, how many

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

utm.description: Filter the numbers by one UTM value, e.g. a source such as facebook.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when the session already built one.

name: wi_get_webinar_attendance_stats
title: Read webinar attendance and show-up rate
